mods.name: Better Than Wolves
mods.description: Better Than Wolves was originally created in Beta 1.4, when FlowerChild remarked that the addition of Wolves added little value to the game, and that there was a lot of better ideas that could have been applied instead. He collected various ideas from the community that were "better than wolves", and created the first version of Better Than Wolves a few days later. This port stays mostly faithful to the original version while adding small improvements and an API for other mods to use. Special thanks to UncleAcid for providing a testing server.

releases.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed client side code being loaded on servers and immediately crashing them. This mod should finally work on servers

He collected various ideas from the community that were "better than wolves", and created the first version of Better Than Wolves a few days later. This port stays mostly faithful to the original version while adding small improvements and an API for other mods to use.

releases.notes:
New features:
- Decorative Grate Block
- Config entry to deactivate wolf dumping and substitute dung with logs
- Item descriptions for hemp and dung

Major changes:
- Now works on Station API Alpha 3
- Replaced How Many Items with Always More Items
- The item viewer mod (AMI) is now optional
- New recipe tabs for Always More Items
- Wind mills and water wheels now have collision blocks around them, this should fix graphical and collision issues in multiplayer
- Crucibles no longer have a strict double stoked fire requirement but still benefit from it

Minor fixes:
- Stoked fire causes damage
- Bellows and gear boxes randomly tick to update themselves after they are loaded in
- Shortened mod name
